f3c5409dcf2b9055649a1f07ca0144bdd737fd37.sourceText: 一个常见错误是用 `system_clock` 做超时判断。如果系统时间被 NTP 或用户手动调回去，程序可能“等很久都不超时”。测耗时和超时都优先用 `steady_clock`。
f3c5409dcf2b9055649a1f07ca0144bdd737fd37.translatedText: A common mistake is using `system_clock` for timeout determination\. If the system time is set back by NTP or manually by the user, the program may "wait a long time without timing out\." For both measuring elapsed time and timeouts, prefer using `steady_clock`\.
